parsetrees.3:
<root><h level="3" i="1">===Effect===</h>
<h level="4" i="2">====Held item====</h>
Restores 1/16 of the holder's maximum <template><title>stat</title><part><name index="1"/><value>HP</value></part></template> (rounded down, but not less than 1) at the end of each turn.

In [[Generation IV]], Leftovers are able to heal the holder regardless of <template><title>m</title><part><name index="1"/><value>Heal Block</value></part></template>. From [[Generation V]] onwards, Leftovers cannot heal Pokémon affected by Heal Block.

<h level="5" i="3">=====Pokémon Legends: Z-A=====</h>
Leftovers restores health once every 10 seconds, even outside of battle, as long as the holder is outside its Poké Ball.

<h level="4" i="4">====Bag item====</h>
When fed into the [[Cram-o-matic]], it is a <template><title>type</title><part><name index="1"/><value>Grass</value></part></template> ingredient that gives 20 points towards the output value.</root>
